t: This is the Shaw Theatre, part of the Pullman London St Pancras hotel, just off Euston Road in Somers Town. It has four hundred and forty-six seats, two large foyers and a bar, and it is also used for exhibitions. It takes its name from George Bernard Shaw, the Irish playwright and critic. He wrote more than sixty plays, including Man and Superman, Pygmalion and Saint Joan, and won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1925.
